source.title: Junior School Curriculum Design: Christian Religious Education, Grade 8 (KICD, First published 2023, Revised 2024, ISBN 978-9914-43-807-9)
source.notes: WebFetch could not extract text from the PDF ('unable to extract text') but reported the file saved locally; the Read tool then parsed the full PDF text natively and verbatim, including cover page, ISBN 978-9914-43-807-9, forewords, all six strands, all sub-strand tables, assessment rubrics, and appendices. Independently confirmed against KICD's own Google Drive index (file ID 1ZVqaVImBDLeGVUbLwA54C8zqWZMsr3V8 on the Grade 8 designs page), whose /preview page shows the exact official filename 'CRE Grade 8 - Revised.pdf', matching the easylearn.co.ke filename 'CRE-Grade-8-Revised.pdf' modulo dashes. All strand/sub-strand headings, SLOs, and KIQs below are transcribed verbatim from the Read output, not summarized. CAVEAT: the document's own strand-heading label is inconsistent between its Table of Contents/body strand headers ('STRAND 3.0 MIRACLES OF JESUS CHRIST') and its own 'SUMMARY OF STRANDS AND SUB-STRANDS' table (which labels the same strand '3.0 The Life and Ministry of Jesus' with an unnumbered sub-header 'Selected Miracles of Jesus Christ' above sub-strands 3.1-3.3). The body strand-table headers used throughout the detailed content consistently say 'Miracles of Jesus Christ' -- that heading is used here as canonical, per the same resolution approach applied to Grade 9 CRE and Grade 8 Creative Arts naming quirks. Content strand/sub-strand topics differ substantially from Grade 9 CRE (different strand set entirely: e.g. Grade 8 has 'The Life and Ministry of Jesus/Miracles of Jesus Christ' and 'Teachings of Jesus Christ' as separate strands, vs Grade 9's single combined 'The Life and Ministry of Jesus Christ' strand; different Bible narratives throughout), confirming Grade 8 is not a re-run of Grade 9 content.

subStrands.name: Origin and Consequences of Sin
specificLearningOutcomes: Explain the origin of sin from the scriptures provided
Examine the consequences of sin after the fall of man
Analyse the causes of sin today
Identify moral values and life skills needed to overcome temptations
Pray to God to overcome temptations in day-to-day life
keyInquiryQuestions: Why is it important to consider the consequences of something before acting?

subStrands.name: God's Plan for Redemption
specificLearningOutcomes: Describe how God demonstrated love to humankind after the fall of man
Examine how God's plan of salvation is fulfilled through Jesus Christ
Explain the importance of redemption after the fall of man
Take part in sharing the love of God with others
Appreciate God's saving grace in their day-to-day life
keyInquiryQuestions: Why is God's redemptive plan important to human kind?
subStrands.notes: Scriptures covered: Genesis 3:15, 12:1-3, Isaiah 53:5-12, 63:5, Galatians 1:3-5, Colossians 1:13-15, 2 Peter 3:9, John 3:16, Ephesians 1:7.

subStrands.name: Faith and God's Promises
specificLearningOutcomes: Describe the background to the call of Abraham
Examine ways Abraham demonstrated faith in God
Apply faith in different situations as exemplified by Abraham
Elaborate the promises made by God to Abraham
Explain the importance of God's promises to Christians today
Apply God's promises in their daily lives
keyInquiryQuestions: How do you apply God's promises in your daily life?

subStrands.name: Abrahamic Covenant
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify covenants in modern life and their importance
Elaborate the covenant made by God to Abraham
Explain the importance of God's covenant with Abraham
Outline the importance of circumcision to Abraham and his descendants
Evaluate characteristics of ungodly covenants today
Establish how to discern ungodly covenants as guided by the word of God
Desire to trust in God at all times
keyInquiryQuestions: Why is Abrahamic covenant important to Christians today?
subStrands.notes: Scriptures covered: Genesis 15:1-18, 17:1-14, James 4:7, Matthew 4:8-10, 7:15-20, 1 Peter 5:8-9.

subStrands.name: Leadership in Israel: Saul
specificLearningOutcomes: Discuss reasons for kingship in Israel
Examine reasons against kingship in Israel
Evaluate King Saul's failures and the consequences
Deduce lessons learnt from the failures of King Saul
Desire to be a God-fearing leader at school and in church
keyInquiryQuestions: Why did King Saul fail in his leadership?
subStrands.notes: Sub-strand name given in the document as 'Leadership in Israel (Saul)' in the summary table and 'Leadership in Israel: Saul' in the body heading; body heading used here. Scriptures covered: 1 Samuel 8:1-20, 13:8-14, 15:7-25.

subStrands.name: Healing of Blind Bartimaeus
specificLearningOutcomes: Describe the healing of blind Bartimaeus
Discuss lessons learnt from the healing of blind Bartimaeus
Apply lessons learnt when faced with health challenges
Desire to depend on God when faced with challenges
keyInquiryQuestions: How does the healing of blind Bartimaeus build your faith in God?

subStrands.name: Calming the Storm
specificLearningOutcomes: Describe the miracle of calming the storm
Outline lessons learnt from the miracle of calming the storm
Identify the challenges they face in daily life
Apply lessons learnt to overcome the challenges they face as youths
Desire to depend on God when faced with challenges
keyInquiryQuestions: How does the miracle of calming the storm relate to challenges facing people today?

subStrands.name: Healing of the Paralytic
specificLearningOutcomes: Describe the healing of the paralytic
Outline lessons learnt from the healing of the paralytic
Examine the Pharisees' opposition to the healing of the paralytic
Apply lessons learnt from the miracle in daily life
Appreciate God's power over sickness and disease
keyInquiryQuestions: How does the healing of the paralytic build your faith in God?

subStrands.name: Teachings on Prayer
specificLearningOutcomes: Outline the importance of prayer in the life of a Christian
Discuss the importance of having faith when they pray to God
Demonstrate love by praying for all people
Apply lessons learnt by praying persistently
Exercise faith whenever they pray to God
keyInquiryQuestions: How do you apply the teachings of Jesus Christ in your day-to-day life?

subStrands.name: The Lost Sheep
specificLearningOutcomes: Describe the parable of the lost sheep
Take part in reaching out to the lost through evangelism
Exemplify God's love by serving all people
keyInquiryQuestions: How does the parable of the lost sheep portray God's love for the sinner?

subStrands.name: The Holy Spirit
specificLearningOutcomes: Describe the outpouring of the Holy Spirit on the day of Pentecost
Analyse ways Christians exemplify the fruit of the Holy Spirit
Take part in church activities to foster responsibility
Explain the importance of participating in Church activities
Desire to be guided by the Holy Spirit in daily life
keyInquiryQuestions: Why should you depend on the Holy Spirit?
subStrands.notes: Scriptures covered: Acts 2:1-11, Galatians 5:22-23 (fruit of the Spirit).

subStrands.name: Acts of Compassion
specificLearningOutcomes: Describe the role of the church in helping the needy
List the needy/those who should be helped, per Leviticus 19:32-33 and Psalms 82:3
Relate acts of compassion itemised in Matthew 25:31-40
Establish those who will inherit the kingdom of God, per Matthew 25:34-40
Distinguish unrighteous acts specified in Matthew 25:41-46
Take part in a community service activity in the school neighbourhood
Desire to participate in acts of charity
keyInquiryQuestions: Why should you participate in Acts of Compassion?

subStrands.name: Family Relationships
specificLearningOutcomes: Outline roles played by different family members
Identify practices which depict healthy family relationships
Outline causes of conflicts in families today
Propose solutions to conflicts facing families today
Describe ways children should relate to their parents
List five values needed to live harmoniously with family members
Utilize the values listed in their interaction with family members
keyInquiryQuestions: How do you relate with your family members?

subStrands.name: Human Sexuality: Responsible Sexual Behaviour
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify forms of sexual abuse and how to avoid or overcome abuse
Evaluate causes of teenage pregnancies today
Examine the consequences of engaging in irresponsible sexual behaviour
Discuss values and life skills needed to avoid irresponsible sexual behaviour
Choose to live responsibly as guided by the word of God
Respect their bodies by living a morally upright life
keyInquiryQuestions: Why should you live responsibly as a youth?
subStrands.notes: Sub-strand titled '6.2 Human Sexuality' with subtitle 'Responsible sexual behaviour' in the summary table. Scriptures covered: 1 Thessalonians 4:3-6, Romans 12:1-2, 1 Corinthians 6:18-20, 1 Peter 2:11. Includes a designated CPO (Child Protection Officer) guest-speaker learning experience on reporting defilement.

subStrands.name: Sacredness of Life
specificLearningOutcomes: Explain the meaning of sacredness of life
Elaborate sacredness of life from the scriptures provided
Discuss how the right to life is violated today
Evaluate causes of suicide in today's society
Examine causes of abortion among teenage girls
Analyse the consequences of violating the right to life
Compile values and life skills needed to uphold sacredness of life
keyInquiryQuestions: How do you uphold sacredness of life?
subStrands.notes: Scriptures covered: Genesis 4:10-11, 9:6, Exodus 20:13, Deuteronomy 18:10, Proverbs 6:16-17, Matthew 6:25, Psalms 139:13-16, Jeremiah 1:5. Covers sensitive topics (suicide, abortion) -- flagged for careful handling in a future build phase.

subStrands.name: Bullying
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify causes of bullying at school and in the community
Analyse the effects of bullying on an individual and the family
Outline values needed to co-exist peacefully from the scriptures provided
Model the value of love in their interaction with others
subStrands.notes: Scriptures covered: 1 John 3:15, 1 Peter 3:8, Romans 14:19, Proverbs 22:10.

subStrands.name: Work: Talents, Gifts and Abilities
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify their God-given talents, gifts and abilities
Take part in different activities to nurture their talents
Describe the parable of the talents in Matthew 25:14-30
Discuss lessons learnt from the parable of the talents
Apply lessons learnt from the parable of talents in daily life
Originate an income-generating enterprise to enhance financial literacy skills
Demonstrate accountability by saving money from the enterprise
Utilize their God given talents, gifts and abilities to serve others
keyInquiryQuestions: How do you discover your talents, gifts and abilities?
How do you use your God-given talents, gifts and abilities?
subStrands.notes: Summary table calls this sub-strand '6.5 Work: Talents and Abilities'; the body section heading is 'Work: Talents, Gifts and Abilities' -- fuller body heading used here. Scriptures covered: James 1:17, Romans 11:29, Matthew 25:14-30. Includes an income-generating enterprise/financial-literacy project component -- similar in kind to the Pre-Technical Studies entrepreneurship strand, needs a build-phase decision on how to quiz a hands-on enterprise project.

subStrands.name: Leisure
specificLearningOutcomes: Explain how they spend their leisure time
Identify reasons for misuse of leisure among youths
Analyse the consequences of misusing leisure
Examine ways of using leisure time constructively
Utilize leisure time appropriately as guided by the scriptures
Compile values and life skills needed for proper use of leisure time
Value leisure time and use it constructively
keyInquiryQuestions: How do you spend your leisure?
